content.title: About
content.content: Lunchmeat is a ready‑to‑eat product made from selected chicken breast, thinly sliced. The meat is cooked, lightly salted and seasoned, making it convenient for quick snacks, salads, sandwiches and fast‑prep meals.

content.title: Interesting Facts
items: Chicken breast is one of the leanest poultry meats, containing very little fat.
Thin slices allow rapid addition of protein to any dish without further cooking.
Lunchmeat is popular in sports nutrition because of its high bioavailable protein content.
The product is usually vacuum‑packed, extending shelf life without added preservatives.
In some countries these sliced meats are called “deli meat” or “cold cuts.”

items.title: High in protein
items.content: Chicken breast provides about 22 g of protein per 100 g, supporting muscle maintenance and post‑exercise recovery.

items.title: Low in fat
items.content: Compared with many meat delicacies, this product contains low levels of saturated fat, suitable for low‑fat diets.

items.title: Source of B‑vitamins
items.content: It contains vitamin B3 (niacin) and B6, which are important for energy metabolism and nervous system health.

items.title: Contains minerals
items.content: Chicken provides iron, phosphorus and zinc, essential for blood formation and immune function.

items.title: Convenient
items.content: Ready to eat without additional cooking, saving time in meal preparation.

items.title: Sodium content
items.content: To enhance flavor the product is often salted, so people monitoring sodium intake should watch portion sizes.

items.title: Allergy potential
items.content: Some individuals may be allergic to chicken or to added seasonings.

items.title: Shelf life after opening
items.content: Once opened, keep refrigerated and consume within 3–5 days.

items.title: Quality control
items.content: Improper storage or temperature abuse can lead to bacterial growth and foodborne illness.

content.title: How to Eat
content.content: Slices can be added to salads, sandwiches, wraps, pasta, rice dishes, or enjoyed as a quick snack. They can also be gently warmed in a pan or microwave if desired.

content.title: Storage
content.content: Store the product in its original vacuum‑sealed package in the refrigerator at 0 °C to +4 °C. After opening, transfer to an airtight container and use within a few days. For longer storage, freezing at –18 °C is acceptable, though texture may change.
